routes.name: Tourist Visa (with Sustainable Development Fee)
routes.summary: Most visitors apply online through the Immigration portal. You pay a one-off visa fee plus a daily Sustainable Development Fee.

other: Bangladesh and Maldives citizens also need a visa and can apply online before travel or on arrival.
Sign the Pledge of Friendship during the application.

stay.note: Visa allows up to 90 days from entry. Extensions must be requested before expiry.

steps: Upload passport copy and photo, enter travel dates.
Pay the visa fee and SDF.

fees.label: Sustainable Development Fee, adult, per day
SDF, ages 6 to under 12, per night

routes.name: Entry Permit for Indian Nationals
routes.summary: Indian citizens do not need a visa. They get an entry permit instead, online or at the border, and pay the SDF.

other: Valid Indian passport or voter ID card.
Under 18 can use a passport or birth certificate with a legal guardian.
SDF is Nu. 1,200 per adult per night, Nu./INR 600 for ages 6 to under 12.

steps: Apply online ahead, or at the point of entry (waits can be long).
